fields.title: Calculate Feature Cost
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: It is proposed to show "how many people are viewing now" every time a product card is opened. Requires a call to the analytics service: 0.008 RUB per call. The card is opened 900k times a day.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 900,000 × 0.008 × 365 ≈ 2.6 million RUB per year. Too expensive for a decorative feature. Instead: compute the aggregate every 5 minutes and serve from cache — cost drops by about 300 times, accuracy of "now" drops to five-minute intervals, which is sufficient for such a feature. Technique: before adding a call to a frequent scenario, multiply by frequency and by 365.
